correctness.rationale: Exact affine ODE integration for every allowed initial condition; derivative is a difference of two exponentials and has at most one root; initial/final positive rankings and minimum sign give an if-and-only-if two-crossing criterion. At the fold, direct differentiation gives A″(t*)=r_f r_s m>0 and the square-root time-gap asymptotic. Rational initial/equilibrium example has exact sign pattern and strictly positive biological rates; standard-library checks reproduce its two roots and 2,456 randomized phase classifications. Finite tests support but do not prove the general statement.

value.rationale: The sharp threshold separates no transient habitat-ranking reversal from exactly two misleading sign reversals even when initial and final preferences agree; it identifies the necessary above/below equilibrium ecological mechanism, an open strict feasible region, and a square-root duration law relevant to timing and interpreting habitat occupancy surveys. This natural classification is stronger than simply re-solving a linear ODE or reporting an arbitrary numeric special case.
